title: Added a stats Page for all heroes

changes.text: In order to see and compare all stats from all heroes another page was added. Also you can turn on a bonus toggle, to see heroes with sample bonus data which is more accurate.
Calculator Page added - now all hero skills display the raw dmg numbers of a base (Level 300/No Items/Div 5 Hero.
Register and Login added (alpha). You can now register free and get a new page -> my heroes. There you can select and save heroes that you have.

title: Changed Homepage and added more content

changes.text: New bosses added for the Old Gods Event.
Adjusted some rankings and logics within the calculcation scripts

title: Changed Homepage and added more content

changes.text: New sites are coming soon. Some I already implemented and these are accessible over the homepage. I added a Shrine page with all current shrines and their effects and ratings. More to come.
Some feature are currently being reworked. That could result in errors, misleading tags or values being 0 or empty. That could effect rankings and hero composition components.
Added a Ranking System page with all current rankings and their details.
Added a Bosses and Totems page with all current bosses and totems, their effects and ratings.
Added a Totems page with a list of all totems available and their (subjective) ratings.
The system now reads all hero skill texts and writes a synergy logic stating what the hero does what benefit. Its still in alpha.
The tierlist now sorts by rating when viewing the page initially.
I added a Composition Tab on each hero detail page, that suggests comps that could work and describes the selected heroes benefits to that comp.
I added more skill text for more legendary heroes. Others to come.
